branches.theme: 4.1 Decimal Place Value & Equivalent Fraction Conversions

details: Decimal places represent power-of-10 denominators: Tenths (1/10), Hundredths (1/100), Thousandths (1/1000).
To convert fraction to decimal: multiply numerator and denominator by a factor that turns denominator into 10, 100, 1000...
Multiplication: Multiply as whole numbers, then place decimal point so decimal places equal sum of decimal places in factors.
Division Method 1: Convert decimals to fractions and multiply by reciprocal.
Division Method 2: Multiply dividend and divisor by same power of 10 to clear divisor decimal.

sub_branches.concept: Metric System Units & Patiganita Historical Link
details: Length: 1 km = 1000 m, 1 m = 100 cm, 1 cm = 10 mm.
Mass & Volume: 1 kg = 1000 g, 1 g = 1000 mg, 1 L = 1000 mL.
History: Sridharacharya's Patiganita contained ancient division problems convertible into modern decimal operations.
evidence_or_examples: Tailor cutting 21 shirts of 1.8 m from a 37.8 m cloth roll
